content: In order to get the feedback on the quality, functionality, and usefulness of the introduced model, we evaluated it in two ways: first, with an automated method using 130 manually annotated dialogues, to prove the robustness of the system, and second – with human tutors from OMB+ – to investigate the user experience. We describe the details as well as the most common errors below.
